title: Kabanos and Sausage Polish Soup
description: A hearty, comforting Polish-inspired soup made with kabanos, sausages, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: In a large pot, cook the kabanos and sausages over medium heat, breaking up the sausages with a spoon as they cook.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the herbal broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the velvety polenta according to the package instructions.
Stir the cooked polenta into the soup and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, topped with a dollop of polish sour cream.
